fields.label: Use This Layout for the Whole Card
fields.description: Hides the board's own field rows; keeps the title, the footer and the card menu

fields.label: Title Field
fields.description: Shown as the card title instead of the board's title

fields.label: Compact Numbers
fields.description: 555K instead of 555,000.00; the full number shows on hover

fields.label: Show Stage Path
fields.description: A thin bar with every stage of the board: done, now, sent back, still ahead; dates on hover

fields.label: Stage Short Names
fields.description: Optional, one per line: Stage=SHORT. Others are shortened on their own (Project Won = PW)

fields.label: Hide Buttons the Next Step Already Shows
Show Buttons in the Form
fields.description: The next step's button and the card buttons also show at the top of the form; several go under Actions

fields.label: Columns
fields.description: How the board's column headers look.

fields.label: Large Column Titles
fields.description: Each column's name bigger, in its color, its count in a pill, a band of its color on top, and room between the filters and the columns. Off: Frappe's own headers.

fields.label: Column Color Field
fields.description: A Color field of the stages' DocType (the board's field links to it), e.g. color: each column takes its stage's own color. Empty: the board column's color.

fields.label: Column Title Font
fields.description: A font the browser has (CSS font-family), e.g. Georgia, serif. Empty: the site's font.

fields.label: Hero Number
fields.description: The big number under the title, its share of a target, and a line under it

fields.label: Line Under It
fields.description: e.g. Cost {total_cost} · margin {=doc.total - doc.total_cost}

fields.label: Next Step
fields.description: What the card asks for now: the first row whose condition holds

fields.label: Checklist
fields.description: Short ✓ / ○ lines: what is done and what isn't

fields.label: Card Lines
fields.description: What each card shows, and where. Reload the board after saving.

fields.label: Progress Bar
fields.description: A thin bar showing Value as a share of Target: green from 100%, orange from 80%, red below

fields.label: Title
fields.description: With a title the bar becomes a box: the amount, what's left, and the bar

fields.label: Second Value
fields.description: A part of the value shown darker in the bar, e.g. what's collected of what's invoiced

fields.label: Only When
fields.description: eval:...

fields.label: Value Only When
fields.description: eval:... The value (and its share) in the box; without it the box shows the parts only

fields.label: Second Value Only When
fields.description: eval:...

fields.label: Left Only When
fields.description: eval:... What is left of the target

fields.label: Left Field
fields.description: A number field holding what is left of the target. Empty: the target less the value.

fields.label: Percent Field
fields.description: A percent field holding how much of the target the value is. Empty: worked out from the two.

fields.label: Progress Parts
fields.description: More amounts in the box's bar after the value, each in its color, with its amount under the bar

fields.label: Card Buttons
fields.description: Buttons on the card; they act without opening the document

fields.label: Color Rules
fields.description: The first rule that matches colors the card's stripe; every match with a badge text adds that badge.
